text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our next objective, the Japanese
Derby, drawing closer, the focus of
Symboli Rudolf's training sessions has
shifted to ironing out the
creases.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Another productive session. Thank you
for
agreeing to be my partner.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
N-not at all... Glad to help... Anyway,
um... I
should go...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: That was... crazy... She's so... fast...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I apologize for
putting you
through so much trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I mean in finding me a training partner. I
expect it
wasn't so easy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can say that again. When I asked
people if they wanted to be running
partners with the Emperor, most of them
backed out and said they weren't
qualified.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I had to pull some strings with a fellow
trainer to
finally secure someone who
was willing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I also owe my partner an apology. I
could see that
she was quite shaken.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I try my best not to intimidate those
around me,
but I can only hold back so
much while on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I suspect I'm so on edge that I
don't even
realize it.
choice_data_list: The actual race is coming up soon,...
The actual race is coming up soon,...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No race symbolizes the dream of all
racers quite
like the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is a prize I must take if I'm to have
any
pride as
Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is little time left until the
race. We
must
buckle down and keep practicing
as best we can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems fulfilled in mind
and body
as she makes progress toward
the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for bringing you all the way
to the
student council office.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to look over
before we
start training. Could you wait
here? I won't be
long.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately not, I'm afraid.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The last time I stepped back from my
student council work, I missed the signs
that one of my
subordinates was in
distress.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can't let that happen again. The only
choice is to
balance both duties.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if this is beyond me, I have no
chance of
realizing my dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh? What's this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf comes to a stop in front of the
student
council office. A sheet of paper
is affixed to the
door.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove's work, I suspect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I do appreciate that she's worried for my

well-being...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But still,
it's unusual for her to resort to
such
drastic measures—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the door is flung open from
within.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ugh, forget this nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian. Going somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Funny time for you to drop by, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm caught in the crossfire between you
and Air
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind explaining to me what
is going
on?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... So Air Groove has been asking
you to
handle the work that would
otherwise have come
to me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The Empress wouldn't take no for an
answer on
this one. Screwed my
schedule right up, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I can only apologize. I take full
responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If not for my failings, Air Groove
wouldn't have
felt the need to increase
your burden in order to
reduce my own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Once again, this is my fault, not yours.
I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm not asking for an apology...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. I'm going on patrol.
The rest is
your problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, this needs to be revised. We'll have
to ask
them to recalculate it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, what's next...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
President? Aren't you supposed to be
training?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What are you working on?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was reviewing the council's budget
proposal for
the upcoming academic
period.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That must be a lot of work. Let me lend
a hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not! I am doing this specifically to reduce your burden.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is no time for you to be filing
paperwork. I'll
take care of this while
you focus on—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Remind me, Air Groove. Which one of us
is the
president?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Delegating the student council's
workload is my job. You can trust me to
do it, no matter what
else I might be
dealing with.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With all due respect—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Do you truly have so little faith in me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly believe I would let my
student
council activities lead to defeat
on the track?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then what's the harm?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...For what it's worth,
I do appreciate the

sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Apologies, Trainer, but I must attend to
this. I'll
be right with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, since you're offering, I
suppose there
is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to burden you with busywork,
but could
you help organize these files?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More work keeps on popping up, to the
point
where our training session ends up
delayed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, Symboli Rudolf insists on
training for
the allotted time.
